certification.introduction: The CE (Conformité Européenne) marking is a European Union certification that verifies a product's compliance with core health, safety and environmental protection standards required for sale in the European Economic Area. As a mandatory certification for product categories including electronics, machinery and medical devices entering EU markets, this designation confirms legal market access across 31 European countries. It remains critical for importers fulfilling EU regulatory obligations. Suppliers holding this certification demonstrate commitment to product quality and responsible manufacturing practices aligning with European sustainability objectives.

aiSummary: Applicable industries: Chemical industry and related chemical sectors
Applicable regions: European Union market
Certification standards: The EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 covers the registration, evaluation, authorization, and restriction of chemicals.
Advantages: Indicates that the product complies with the EU's requirements for chemical safety and environmental management, ensuring safe use for buyers and compliant imports.
certification.introduction:
The REACH Certificate (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) is managed by the European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) under EU Regulation EC 1907/2006. This certification ensures that chemicals used in products comply with safety standards when manufactured, imported, or sold within the European Economic Area (EEA). It prioritises human health and environmental protection through rigorous risk assessment and transparency in chemical usage. 

All products containing chemical substances sold in the EU must adhere to REACH regulations, including electronics, textiles, toys, and industrial goods. Certification verifies compliance with restricted substance lists and safety standards, ensuring market access eligibility and demonstrating alignment with EU regulatory requirements. This is critical for buyers targeting European markets or prioritising supply chain sustainability.

Applicable regions: The European Union and major global markets
Certification standards: Restricting the content of harmful substances such as lead, mercury, and cadmium

certification.introduction:
The Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Directive is a regulation established by the European Union to limit the use of specific hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment. Managed by the European Commission, the directive reduces environmental and health risks by restricting substances such as lead, mercury and cadmium, ensuring safer production and disposal methods for technology products.  

RoHS compliance is a legal requirement for electronic products sold within the EU, covering items ranging from household appliances to industrial equipment. Products meeting this standard demonstrate adherence to stringent safety protocols, not only minimising legal barriers in cross-border trade but also proving reliability to buyers prioritising supply chain sustainability and regulatory compliance.

Applicable regions: European Union

certification.introduction:
The EU Regulation on the Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH, Regulation No. EC 1907/2006) is enforced by the European Chemicals Agency (ECHA). This regulation mandates manufacturers and importers to register chemical substances, conduct safety assessments, and restrict the use of hazardous substances to safeguard human health and environmental safety.  

REACH is legally binding across EU member states and applies to products containing chemical substances, including industrial goods, electronic devices, and consumer items. Compliance certification verifies that products meet EU safety standards, enables businesses to secure market access, and demonstrates a commitment to global chemical safety standards.

aiSummary: Applicable industries: Medical devices
Applicable regions: United States
Certification standards: ASTM F136 Technical Specification for Medical Titanium Alloys
Advantages: Meets the requirements for materials intended for human implantation and exhibits excellent biocompatibility.
certification.introduction:
ASTM F136-13 is a material specification established by the internationally recognised standards organisation ASTM International. This standard defines requirements for titanium alloy (Ti-6Al-4V ELI) used in surgical implants, ensuring biocompatibility, mechanical properties, and corrosion resistance to safeguard patient safety and device reliability in medical applications.  

Specifically applied in orthopaedic/dental implant sectors, the standard is frequently referenced in FDA regulatory approvals. Compliance documentation confirms suitability for long-term human implantation, reducing risks of adverse reactions – a critical factor for buyers procuring medical devices requiring stringent quality validation.

verifiedManufactruers.explain: Custom Manufacturers are service-specific Verified Suppliers who are third-party verified to provide dedicated production lines and customization capabilities that help Alibaba.com buyers transform their ideas into actual products.

details.text:
Shenzhen Right Grand Jewelry Co., Ltd.- founded in 2007 -is a leading manufacturer and exporter of high-quality Body Jewelry and Fashion Jewelry based in Shenzhen, China.

We specialize in ASTM F136 Titanium Body Piercing Jewelry and Stainless Steel Fashion Jewelry, offering both OEM & ODM services to global customers. With 100% of our products exported worldwide, we take pride in delivering innovative designs, reliable quality, and fast service that meet the highest international standards.

Our factory is equipped with advanced production lines and supported by a professional team of 10 experienced designers and 10 skilled QC inspectors, ensuring every piece is perfectly crafted. We continuously develop 500+ new designs each month to help our partners stay ahead of market trends.

To support our clients business growth, we provide:

Free Samples & Free Mold Cost for new designs

Free HD Product Photos for online promotion

Fast Shipping (7-25 days) worldwide

Transparent pricing & dedicated customer service

At Right Grand Jewelry, quality is our culture, customer satisfaction is our mission, and mutual benefit is our foundation for long-term cooperation.

details.question: Is your titanium jewelry safe for long-term body piercing?
details.answer: All our body piercing jewelry is made from ASTM F136 implant grade titanium, widely used in medical implants. It is nickel-free, lead-free, and hypoallergenic, suitable for sensitive skin and long-term wear. Each batch is strictly quality-checked by our in-house QC team to ensure smooth surfaces, accurate threads, and stable performance for professional piercing use.

details.question: What quality control do you have before shipment?
details.answer: We operate a 10-member professional QC team covering material inspection, CNC precision, polishing, threading accuracy, stone setting stability, and final appearance checks. Every order is inspected before packing to reduce defect rates and ensure consistency, helping buyers minimize after-sales issues and returns.

details.question: Can you support customization and private label orders?
details.answer: Customization is one of our core strengths. We support custom designs, sizes, gauges, colors, stones, logos, and packaging. With 10 experienced designers and in-house production, we offer free samples, free mold cost for most designs, and fast sampling to help brands launch new collections efficiently.

details.question: What is your MOQ for wholesale and custom orders?
details.answer: We support low MOQ, suitable for small brands, studios, and test orders. MOQ varies by design and process, but we aim to stay flexible. For custom projects, we help optimize structure and materials to balance cost and MOQ, making scaling easier for growing businesses.

details.question: How fast can you ship bulk or custom orders?
details.answer: Standard production and shipping usually take 7-25 days, depending on order quantity and customization level. However, at the same time, we also support 48 hours dispatch.With our stable supply chain and in-house manufacturing in Shenzhen, we ensure reliable lead times, helping buyers keep inventory turnover fast and avoid stock delays.

details.question: Do you provide product images and marketing materials?
details.answer: We offer free HD product photos, and can support customized images or content for listings, catalogs, and online marketing. This helps buyers save time and cost while improving listing performance and click-through rates on platforms like Alibaba International Station.

details.question: Why choose Right Grand as your long-term supplier?
details.answer: We are a 100% export-focused manufacturer specializing in body and fashion jewelry, launching 500+ new designs monthly. With strong R&D, strict QC, flexible MOQ, fast delivery, and deep customization capability, we help brands reduce sourcing risk, speed up product launches, and stay competitive in fast-changing markets.

details.question: Will the color fade or plating peel over time?
details.answer: For titanium jewelry, color is achieved mainly through PVD coating or anodizing, which offers strong adhesion and corrosion resistance. Under normal wear conditions, the color remains stable. We also provide usage and care guidance based on different markets and lifestyles to help extend color retention.

It prioritises human health and environmental protection through rigorous risk assessment and transparency in chemical usage. 

All products containing chemical substances sold in the EU must adhere to REACH regulations, including electronics, textiles, toys, and industrial goods. Certification verifies compliance with restricted substance lists and safety standards, ensuring market access eligibility and demonstrating alignment with EU regulatory requirements. This is critical for buyers targeting European markets or prioritising supply chain sustainability.

items.introduction:
The Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Directive is a regulation established by the European Union to limit the use of specific hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment. Managed by the European Commission, the directive reduces environmental and health risks by restricting substances such as lead, mercury and cadmium, ensuring safer production and disposal methods for technology products.  

RoHS compliance is a legal requirement for electronic products sold within the EU, covering items ranging from household appliances to industrial equipment. Products meeting this standard demonstrate adherence to stringent safety protocols, not only minimising legal barriers in cross-border trade but also proving reliability to buyers prioritising supply chain sustainability and regulatory compliance.

items.introduction:
ASTM F136-13 is a material specification established by the internationally recognised standards organisation ASTM International. This standard defines requirements for titanium alloy (Ti-6Al-4V ELI) used in surgical implants, ensuring biocompatibility, mechanical properties, and corrosion resistance to safeguard patient safety and device reliability in medical applications.  

Specifically applied in orthopaedic/dental implant sectors, the standard is frequently referenced in FDA regulatory approvals. Compliance documentation confirms suitability for long-term human implantation, reducing risks of adverse reactions – a critical factor for buyers procuring medical devices requiring stringent quality validation.
